model_repository.observed_model_size_metadata: 2B params / BF16 on Hugging Face surface; upstream model card evaluation table identifies MOSS-TTS-Realtime as 1.7B

source_direct_findings: The official model card defines MOSS-TTS-Realtime as a context-aware multi-turn streaming TTS model for real-time voice agents, conditioning on both textual and acoustic history and producing incremental audio.
The official language table includes German (de) in a 20-language set.
The official model card reports 180 ms warm TTFB and RTF 0.51, measured with SDPA plus torch.compile on a single NVIDIA L20 GPU. These are upstream measurements only.
The official family/model surfaces identify the realtime model as approximately 1.7B/2B-class and BF16.

The official quickstart uses CUDA 12.8-oriented PyTorch installation and loads OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer with trust_remote_code=True. This creates an explicit quarantine/source-inspection gate before execution in Frankenstein infrastructure.
The official repository license observed at the pinned source commit is Apache-2.0.
project_inferences_not_runtime_facts: Multi-turn text+acoustic context is unusually aligned with Frankenstein's long-running conversational voice goal and could reduce chunk-to-chunk or turn-to-turn acoustic identity drift compared with isolated-utterance TTS.
The upstream L20 latency result cannot be transferred to the current clay-direct-dev target, which has no GPU and no observable audio output path in the current Trigger-4 hardware receipt.

Because the current TTS001 physical audible-output boundary is already blocked and owned by an existing semantic key, opening a second target-runtime dispatch for MOSS now would add blocked breadth rather than evidence depth.
security_and_execution_gates: Do not execute the remote audio tokenizer code outside an admitted disposable sandbox before source/dependency inspection.
Do not treat the Hugging Face model identifier as an exact artifact pin until an exact revision and artifact hashes are captured by the quarantine downloader or equivalent admitted mechanism.
Do not infer CPU realtime capability, German listening quality, male-voice stability, cancellation correctness, or resource coexistence from upstream source claims.
counterhypotheses: The model's multi-turn context may increase memory/KV cost enough to make it less suitable than lighter stateless TTS under Frankenstein's whole-system resource envelope.
Upstream German language support may not deliver acceptable German pronunciation, names/numbers/technical vocabulary, or stable male identity on the exact Frankenstein fixtures.
A lighter Qwen3-TTS 0.6B or other candidate may win the end-to-end quality/latency frontier despite MOSS-TTS-Realtime's stronger context architecture.
next_exact_action: Keep T7-TTS-011 source-pinned and non-dispatched. First close the existing T7-TTS-001 audible physical-target gate with the same semantic key on an admitted host exposing real audio output. Separately, when a target with sufficient accelerator/resource envelope is admitted, quarantine-download and hash an exact MOSS-TTS-Realtime revision before any bounded comparison.
